messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, and we can offer exactly that: our full need of 23,400 pc a year, binding for 24 or 36 months.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a change of 10.1%, so this volume is well founded and lets you plan capacity.

Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 79.5%, so we need the agreed 42-day lead time rather than 54 days.

Please review the attached packages. If the price exceeds your own approval limit, could your pricing committee review them? We would also welcome a cost breakdown or any cheaper seal variant.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our neues Angebot. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We do not provide cost breakdowns, and alternative seal variants are not available for this specification. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We note your delivery data; however, our high capacity utilisation strictly requires a 54-day lead time to ensure reliability. This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide.

Our offer is valid for 7 days. Our offer: a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
